caption: The drawing consists of a square with a thin, double-lined border in gold and black set against a plain light background. Centered within the square is a symmetrical arrangement featuring four green leaves with yellow detailing and prominent veins, positioned at diagonal points (top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right). Interspersed between the leaves are four stylized red and white elements with rounded and pointed sections, resembling fish or wrapped candies, oriented horizontally and vertically. These red and white elements are arranged so that their rounded sides form a loose, open circular shape in the center. Inside the open space at the center, the letters "FEL" are inscribed in black. The composition uses a limited palette of green, yellow, red, pink, and white with precise, clean lines and clear color separations.
title: Pieced Autograph Quilt (1 Piece)
